## Gleason et al. (2008), temperature-reduced second-order BM

Record: `e_feooh_gleason_2008_bm2_1` · Model: `BM2`

**Outcome: Coefficient parity achieved.**

**Scope:** Comparison with the source parameterization.
**Comparison basis:** Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

[Stored EOS coefficients and source](../material-summaries/e_feooh.md#record-e_feooh_gleason_2008_bm2_1)

### What this result establishes

**Separate source-review status:** primary\_source\_validated.
**Usage recommendation:** See the stored EOS qualifications; no recommendation is inferred here.

- Source-protocol reconstruction, not an assertion of an independently measured epsilon-FeOOH thermal EOS. All 49 hot Table 2 volumes are reduced to 300 K with the paper's alpha0=2.3e-5 K^-1 before the pooled fixed-V0 BM2 fit. This recovers K0=158.099 GPa; fitting the raw hot volumes as though they lay on the reference isotherm instead gives 175.624 GPa. The correction is numerically identifiable but not printed in the epsilon-specific prose, and the source weights are unavailable.
- This named numerical assessment alone does not establish author-workflow reproduction, physical accuracy or recommendation for use.

### Data and reconstruction method

- **Dataset identifiers:** epsilon\_feooh\_gleason\_2008\_deposit\_table2\_pvt
- **Observations:** 49
- **Fit kind:** source\_pooled\_multitemperature\_pv\_reduced\_to\_300k
- **Selection:** all 49 deposited P21mn epsilon-FeOOH rows; no exclusions; volumes reduced from their measured 473.15-673.15 K states to 300 K before fitting
- **Objective:** unweighted\_pressure\_residuals\_after\_volume\_reduction
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** K0
- **Fixed parameters:** V0

Unspecified selections, weights, fixed values or error conventions remain unknown; they have not been inferred for this report.

### Curves, residuals and fit error

![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for e_feooh_gleason_2008_bm2_1](figures/e_feooh_gleason_2008_bm2_1-curves.svg#only-light)
![Original/source and refitted curves with pressure residuals for e_feooh_gleason_2008_bm2_1](figures/e_feooh_gleason_2008_bm2_1-curves-dark.svg#only-dark)

| Fit | Pressure RMS error (GPa) |
| --- | ---: |
| Original / source fit | 0.946 |
| Reconstruction / refit | 0.946 |

Both fits use the same 49 recovered audit input rows. Residual = P(model) − P(input), evaluated at each input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive pressure error, not a parameter uncertainty or the optimizer's weighted/latent-coordinate objective.

**Volume coordinate:** cell\_volume\_a3 reduced to 300 K. **Row selection:** all rows.

Curves use full stored coefficients. For thermal data, separate isotherms are labelled; when there are more than five temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum sampled temperatures are shown. Residuals include every selected row at its own temperature. Coordinate error bars appear only where the row reader can recover all widths; their meaning remains that of the source dataset (including digitization widths). Missing bars do not mean zero error. No uncertainty band is inferred.
